answer: Grow the network as a trellis, not a crowd: group identities into small cells where neighbours share one finite action budget per epoch. A haven for honest agents follows — one voice can act freely, but a farmer who plants fifty masks inside a cell still draws on that same single budget, so splitting gains nothing. To reach more cells the masks must mirror real strangers' cells and win budget there, where outsiders watch and can starve abusive neighbours. Sybil power stops scaling with headcount; it scales only with genuinely separate social ground.
